summary: Iconex is a labeling and receipt-products manufacturer, part of the M2S Group, headquartered in Morristown, Tennessee, with additional operations in the UK and France; it describes over 130 years of variable-information-print heritage tracing to the invention of the paper receipt.

Iconex markets linerless labels and thermal receipt paper specifically for quick-service restaurant order identification, claiming its solutions are used by "Top 7" hospitality chains and citing vendor-reported improvements of up to 95% in order accuracy and roughly 10% reduction in operational costs for adopters. (Scope note: The "Top 7" hospitality chains and accuracy/cost figures are Iconex's own marketing claims; no specific chain names or independent verification were found.)
Iconex is exhibiting at FSTEC 2026 to showcase labeling innovations for restaurant operators, indicating continued investment in the restaurant/QSR vertical.
MURTEC 2018 listed a MAXStick Products topic table on order accuracy moderated by Taco John's Vice President of Operations Rocky Clark.
StickyLabels.store displays McDonald's, Starbucks, Just Eat, Burger King, KFC, Little Caesars and Chick-fil-A logos while claiming leading companies use MAXStick.
StickyLabels.store publishes a testimonial attributed to McDonald's Germany expressing satisfaction with MAX International/MAXStick.
POS Supply's current Iconex buying guide references compatibility with linerless printers including Epson TM-L100 and Bixolon SRP-S300.
Food Logistics reported the September 2026 launch of Iconex RFID linerless technology for food/grocery and other supply-chain markets.
Iconex's current Update Corner lists an announcement titled 'Iconex Acquires Heartland Label Printers.'
